abstract: Native App Intents for Capacitor apps: Siri, Shortcuts, App Shortcuts, Spotlight, Action button, Apple Intelligence, widgets and controls. Covers routing intents into the web layer through Universal Links / OpenURLIntent and appUrlOpen or a local plugin with a pending-route store, headless background intents, App Group data sharing, entity/query/phrase traps, the iOS 26/27 APIs (supportedModes, continueInForeground, LongRunningIntent, execution targets, Spotlight indexing, AppIntentsTesting) with availability gating for Capacitor 8 (iOS 15) and 9 (iOS 16), file placement and target membership, and the UIScene (Capacitor 8.5+) effect on URL delivery.
